title: 第21章 我亲自教训他们第22章 护着她有何不可
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第21章我，亲自教训他们纪寒死死摁住唐凝的脑袋，唐凝直不起身，才好起来的膝盖，此刻又疼得她牙齿直打战。
“纪寒，”唐凝的声音像是费劲地从咽喉里发出来，很是沙哑，“你答应我爸爸，说会好好照顾我，如今，你就是这么践踏我的？”
纪寒闻言，神色有所动摇，手上的力气放松了不少。
纪馨宁见状，连忙道：“唐凝姐，这么多年二哥照顾你，疼你，你不知足就算了，还要搬出死去的唐叔叔这么逼他，未免太过分了。”
纪寒一向讨厌唐凝搬出唐父来说话，这让他感到被胁迫。
如果不是因为爷爷喜欢唐凝，且纪寒和她多年感情，唐凝又对他言听计从。
兴许，他早和她分开了。
“你给我闭嘴。”听到纪馨宁提到父亲，唐凝来了气，使劲抬起一张冰冷含怒的脸，“你没资格提我父亲，我嫌恶心。”
“唐凝姐，你就这么讨厌我吗？二哥，你看唐凝姐，怎么这么容不下我。”
“早知道，我就不该回国，免得让你这么恨我。”纪馨宁委屈低下头，快哭了的模样。
纪寒心疼得不得了，一怒之下又使劲把唐凝的头摁下去，“你简直无药可救，给我好好道歉，直到宁宁原谅你为止。”
“纪寒，你放开我……”唐凝挣扎。
她越挣扎，纪寒越用力，仿佛要把她的脑袋摁到地底下，脖子都快要被压断了。
那一刻，唐凝恨透了纪寒。
这就是她爱了五年的男人，竟然一二再为了所谓的妹妹，不惜伤害她。
“唐凝，好好在这跪着道歉。”纪寒压着她的脑袋，不管她怎么挣扎都无济于事。
纪馨宁看着唐凝挣扎起不来的样子，娇柔的面容上浮起阴险的笑。
她瞥见床头柜的保温壶，眼底闪过阴险。
忽然‘哎呀’一声。
保温壶从柜子上掉下来，盖子松开，里面的热水溅出来。

唐凝‘啊’的叫出声，撑在地上的手被热水溅到，顿时红了一大片。
“唐凝……”纪寒震惊。
此时，病房门被推开。
一道身影疾步进入病房，正好看到这一幕。
只见唐凝被纪寒摁着脑袋，散乱着发丝跪在地上，掉落在她旁边的保温壶洒出热水袅袅。
唐凝的手背被烫得红彤彤一片，看得纪瑾修冷冽的双眼瞬间变得阴鸷。
“唐凝。”
纪瑾修三两步冲过去，怒火从胸口腾腾燃烧，重重挥了纪寒一拳。
这一拳劲很大，打得纪寒摔在病床上。
纪馨宁惊呼出声，“二哥……大哥，你怎么能打二哥？”
纪瑾修狠狠剜了纪馨宁一眼，吓得她不敢看他。
随后纪瑾修蹲下身扶起唐凝，眼底的阴鸷散去，浮起浓浓的心疼，“唐凝，你怎么样？”
唐凝疼，疼得她直哆嗦，额头上渗出冷汗，“纪瑾修，你来了。”
她声音哽咽，手腕弯着，动都不敢动一下，眼底蓄满了委屈的泪水，看起来格外惹人心疼。
纪瑾修胸口狠狠揪了一下。
他才跟她分开一会，就被人欺负成这样？
“大哥，你居然为了唐凝打我？”
纪寒从床上起来，指着纪瑾修怀里的唐凝怒斥，“她性格骄纵，受伤是她活该，说不定吃了教训就能学好了……”
“给我闭嘴！”
纪瑾修凛冽的眼神如刀子似的，射向纪寒，“这笔账，等会慢慢跟你算。”

纪瑾修弯腰横打抱起唐凝，厉声吩咐：“看好他们！”
说完，抱着唐凝迅速离开病房去找医生。
content_en:
Chapter 21 I personally taught them a lesson. Ji Han held Tang Ning's head tightly. Tang Ning couldn't stand up straight. Her knee, which had just recovered, was so painful that her teeth were chattering.
"Ji Han," Tang Ning's voice seemed to come out of her throat with difficulty, and was very hoarse, "you promised my father that you would take good care of me, and now, this is how you trample on me?"
When Ji Han heard this, his expression was shaken, and the strength in his hands relaxed a lot.
Seeing this, Ji Xinning quickly said: "Sister Tang Ning, my second brother has taken care of you and loved you for so many years. If you are not satisfied, forget it. It would be too much to force him to move out the dead Uncle Tang."
Ji Han always hated Tang Ning's bringing up Tang's father to speak, which made him feel coerced.
If it weren't for her grandfather's liking for Tang Ning and Ji Han's relationship with her for many years, Tang Ning would have followed his advice.
Perhaps, he had already separated from her.
"Shut up." Hearing Ji Xinning mention her father, Tang Ning became angry and raised her cold and angry face, "You have no right to mention my father. I find it disgusting."
"Sister Tang Ning, do you hate me so much? Second brother, look at Sister Tang Ning, why can't you tolerate me so much?"
"If I had known earlier, I shouldn't have returned to China, lest you hate me so much." Ji Xinning lowered her head in humiliation, looking like she was about to cry.
Ji Han was so distressed that he pushed Tang Ning's head down in anger, "You are hopeless. Please apologize until Ning Ning forgives you."
"Ji Han, let me go..." Tang Ning struggled.
The more she struggled, the harder Ji Han pressed, as if he was trying to push her head into the ground, and her neck was about to be crushed.
At that moment, Tang Ning hated Ji Han.
This was the man she had loved for five years, and he was willing to hurt her again and again for the sake of his so-called sister.
"Tang Ning, kneel here and apologize." Ji Han pressed her head. No matter how hard she struggled, it was to no avail.
Ji Xinning looked at Tang Ning struggling to get up, and a sinister smile appeared on her delicate face.
She glanced at the thermos on the bedside table, and a sinister flash appeared in her eyes.
Suddenly there was a sound of ‘Oops’.
The thermos fell off the cabinet, the lid came loose, and the hot water inside spilled out.
Tang Ning screamed "Ah", and her hand on the ground turned red immediately when the hot water splashed on it.
"Tang Ning..." Ji Han was shocked.
At this time, the ward door was pushed open.
A figure quickly entered the ward, just in time to see this scene.
Tang Ning was seen kneeling on the ground with her head held down by Ji Han, her hair disheveled, and hot water dripping from the thermos flask that fell next to her.
The back of Tang Ning's hand was burned red, and Ji Jinxiu's cold eyes instantly turned sinister.
"Tang Ning."
Ji Jinxiu rushed over in two or two steps, anger burning from his chest, and punched Ji Han hard.
This punch was so powerful that Ji Han fell onto the hospital bed.
Ji Xinning exclaimed, "Second brother...Eldest brother, how can you beat the second brother?"
Ji Jinxiu gave Ji Xinning a hard look, scaring her so much that she didn't dare to look at him.
Then Ji Jinxiu knelt down and helped Tang Ning up. The sinister look in his eyes dissipated, and he felt deep distress, "Tang Ning, how are you?"
Tang Ning was in pain, the pain made her tremble, and cold sweat broke out on her forehead, "Ji Jinxiu, you're here."
Her voice was choked, her wrists were bent, and she didn't dare to move. Her eyes were filled with tears of grievance, and she looked particularly distressed.
Ji Jinxiu pinched his chest hard.
He had only been separated from her for a while, and he was bullied like this?
"Brother, you actually hit me because of Tang Ning?"
Ji Han got up from the bed, pointed at Tang Ning in Ji Jinxiu's arms and angrily said, "She has an arrogant personality. She deserves to be injured. Maybe she can learn from it after learning a lesson..."
"Shut up!"
Ji Jinxiu's sharp eyes were like knives, directed at Ji Han, "I will settle this account with you later."
Ji Jinxiu bent down and picked up Tang Ning, and sternly ordered: "Watch them!"
After saying that, he hugged Tang NingxunLeave the ward quickly to find a doctor.
